verdict.rationale: LangSmith's own docs say it automates workflows with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations. Users can set threshold alerts with stacked filter conditions that route to any HTTP endpoint via webhook, and filtered, sampled evaluators run automatically on production traces. Together these let users define conditions that trigger actions on trace events. missing for 10: detailed docs on the automation rules feature itself (available trigger conditions and action types such as adding to datasets or queues), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automate workflows with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations.
for Errors and Latency, you can use the filter builder to stack conditions on fields such as Status, Run Type, Tag, and Error.
Alerts can route to Slack, PagerDuty, Dynatrace, or any HTTP endpoint via webhook.
Set up evaluators to run automatically on production traces: safety checks, format validation, quality heuristics, and reference-free LLM-as-judge. Apply filters and sampling rates to control costs.
